event_description: Triggered when an email sent from epilot bounces, is rejected, or cannot be sent. One event per failure notification. Carries message metadata (subject, tags, thread, related entities) for filtering; the message body and attachments are never included.

json_schema.description: Entity ID of the message that failed
Entity ID of the thread the message belongs to
Email address the message was sent from (the mailbox to check when sends keep failing)
Recipients this failure is about. BOUNCE/REJECT: only the recipients newly bounced or rejected by this notification. ERROR: every recipient, because the send itself failed.
BOUNCE: the recipient mail server returned the email. REJECT: the email was rejected before sending. ERROR: the email could not be sent (e.g. Outlook or SMTP connection error).
Provider error text: bounce diagnostic code, reject reason or send error
Sending provider of the message, e.g. "outlook". Absent for emails sent by epilot.
RFC 5322 Message-ID header of the email, to correlate with mail server logs
epilot user ID of the person who sent the email
Topic of the thread the message belongs to
Inbox bucket of the thread (see GET /v2/email-settings/inbox-buckets)

attribute.description: Message attribute holding the relation, e.g. "ticket"

json_schema.description: Entities the message is related to (tickets, opportunities, contacts, ...), excluding its thread

Who sent the email: "manual" (a user in the inbox), "automation" (an automation, including the emails of a campaign), "workflow", "partner", "bulk" or "system". Absent when the sender was not recorded.

IDs of the automation flows behind the email, the flow that sent it last; earlier IDs are the automations whose changes triggered it. A campaign sends its emails through its own flow (the campaign's flow_id). Absent when no automation sent the email or the flow was not recorded.
